description: In collaboration with Bear Archery, the revered Fred Bear camouflage pattern comes to life through Rothco’s legendary outdoor apparel and gear, including our Tactical Operator Cap. Each item in the Fred Bear Camouflage collection has been crafted using the iconic Fred Bear camo pattern. Field-Proven Design: In addition to shielding your eyes from the sun’s rays, the Fred Bear Camo Tactical Operator Cap provides the tactical functionality you need in the field. This operator hat features 3 separate loop fields: the front is for displaying flag and morale patches, the top is for attaching an IR marker, and the back is for mounting name tape. Rugged & Long-Lasting: These camouflage hats are built with a breathable 55% cotton / 45% polyester blend for unmatched resiliency and easy-to-care-for maintenance. These tactical field hats are not afraid to get down and dirty while out in the wilderness. Keep Cool, Stay Focused: This camo hat features 4 reinforced vents on the top to help circulate airflow around your head, allowing you to focus on the task at hand. The military-styled hat is great for hunters, tactical operators, security officials, airsoft players, and more. One Size Fits Most: Our tactical hats use an adjustable hook and loop strap for a snug fit that is perfect for most head sizes, ensuring the cap stays in place.
